       /\ req \in [Proc -> [Proc -> Nat]]

       /\ network \in [Proc -> [Proc -> Seq(Message)]]

       NEW CONSTANT q \in Proc \ {p},

                                                    ![p] = Tail(network[q][p])]][p][q],
                                       AckMessage)]]
       /\ UNCHANGED <<ack, crit>> 
PROVE  /\ ack' \in [Proc -> SUBSET Proc]
       /\ crit' \in SUBSET Proc
